verdict.rationale: Rippling documents its own APIs for building custom apps across HR, IT, and finance, plus developer docs, a sandbox, and a CLI for deploying Rippling-hosted integrations. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI can do; the pack mainly describes UI features such as pay runs, benefits enrollment and time tracking, with no matching endpoints. Missing for 10: documented API-to-UI parity, API coverage for core actions like running payroll, approving pay runs and benefits changes, and independent or hands-on confirmation of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Leverage Rippling’s unified platform and APIs to build custom apps that extend functionality across HR, IT, and finance.
Access to developer documentation and sandbox environment
The Flux commands as part of the Rippling CLI allow both first-party and third-party App developers to create, manage and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations.
